name: RP Grand Budapest Hotel look
description: After The Grand Budapest Hotel (2014): pastel, low contrast, lifted black and a soft white, pink-red in the shadows and mids with a faint pink highlight, pinks, magentas and violets forward, greens quiet. Skin held near neutral. Our own numbers, measured from five stills; strength set at 100 percent of the first draft on the operator's letter, 2026-11-07.
